blocks.en: Section 2: Test Methods Part 2

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解均一性（Uniformity of Dosage Units）、容器內容量（Container Contents）及可浸出物/可提取物（Leachables and Extractables）的要求與適用原則
blocks.en: Understand the requirements and application principles for uniformity of dosage units, container contents, and leachables and extractables

blocks.zh: 掌握容器密封完整性（Container–Closure Integrity）的驗證要求與監管框架
blocks.en: Master the validation requirements and regulatory framework for container-closure integrity

blocks.zh: 了解眼用製劑的特定測試（Specific Tests）：黏度、抗氧化劑、再懸浮性、粒徑、滴量、添加物質
blocks.en: Understand the specific tests for ophthalmic products: viscosity, antioxidants, resuspendability, particle size, drop size, added substances

blocks.zh: 能夠整合所有通用與特定測試，建立完整的眼用製劑品質規格體系
blocks.en: Be able to integrate all universal and specific tests to build a complete quality specification system for ophthalmic products

blocks.zh: Uniformity, Container Contents, Leachables & Extractables | 均一性、容器內容量、可浸出/提取物
blocks.en: Uniformity, Container Contents, Leachables & Extractables

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Leachables（可浸出物）vs Extractables（可提取物）的關鍵區別：
blocks.en: The key difference between leachables and extractables:

blocks.zh: Extractables（可提取物）：在嚴苛條件下（如強溶劑、高溫）從包材中強制提取的化學物質。是實驗室研究結果，代表最壞情況的「潛力」清單。
blocks.en: Extractables: chemicals forcibly extracted from packaging materials under harsh conditions (such as strong solvents and high temperature). A laboratory study result representing the worst-case "potential" list.

blocks.zh: Leachables（可浸出物）：在正常儲存和使用條件下，實際從包材遷移進入藥品的化學物質。是患者真正接觸到的風險。
blocks.en: Leachables: chemicals that actually migrate from the packaging materials into the drug product under normal storage and use conditions. This is the risk the patient is really exposed to.

blocks.zh: 評估流程：先做 Extractables 研究確定化合物清單，再做 Leachables 研究確認實際遷移量，最後做毒理安全評估（TTC 分析或物種特定毒理）。
blocks.en: Evaluation flow: first conduct an extractables study to establish the list of compounds, then a leachables study to confirm the actual amounts migrating, and finally a toxicological safety assessment (TTC analysis or species-specific toxicology).

blocks.zh: Container–Closure Integrity（容器密封完整性）：不僅是「蓋子蓋緊了」，而是需要透過驗證試驗（如 CCIT，Container Closure Integrity Testing）證明微生物無法穿透密封系統，貫穿整個貨架壽命。
blocks.en: Container-closure integrity: it is not just "the cap is on tight"; it must be demonstrated through validation testing (such as CCIT, container closure integrity testing) that microorganisms cannot penetrate the sealing system, throughout the entire shelf life.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: E&L 評估就像選擇咖啡杯材質：
blocks.en: An E&L assessment is like choosing the material of a coffee cup:

blocks.zh: Extractables 研究：把塑膠杯放在有機溶劑裡浸泡 24 小時，找出所有可能「跑出來」的化學物質——這是最壞情況下的可能清單
blocks.en: Extractables study: soak the plastic cup in organic solvent for 24 hours to find every chemical that could possibly "come out", the worst-case list of possibilities

blocks.zh: Leachables 研究：用這個杯子實際裝熱咖啡放三年，定期檢測咖啡裡實際出現了哪些遷移物——這才是患者真實接觸的風險
blocks.en: Leachables study: actually fill this cup with hot coffee and keep it for three years, testing regularly to see which migrants actually appear in the coffee; this is the risk the patient really faces

blocks.zh: 毒理評估：問「每天喝這杯咖啡，攝入這些物質的量，對健康有影響嗎？」
blocks.en: Toxicological assessment: ask "if I drink this coffee every day, does the amount of these substances I take in affect my health?"

blocks.zh: 眼用製劑的挑戰在於：眼部路徑的毒理資料非常稀缺，通常只能借用靜脈注射或口服的毒理資料推算，不確定性高。
blocks.en: The challenge for ophthalmic products is that toxicology data for the ocular route are very scarce; usually one can only borrow intravenous or oral toxicology data to extrapolate, so the uncertainty is high.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: E&L 評估需在變更時重新評估：任何製程、配方或包材變更都可能影響浸出物。CDMO 在客戶要求工藝優化時，必須評估是否觸發重新進行 E&L 研究。
blocks.en: The E&L assessment must be re-evaluated when changes are made: any change in process, formulation or packaging material may affect leachables. When a client requests process optimization, a CDMO must assess whether it triggers a repeat of the E&L study.

blocks.zh: 眼部 E&L 評估的特殊挑戰：眼部（尤其是眼內注射）直接接觸神經組織，毒性閾值（TTC）不能直接套用口服標準。且眼科 TK/PK 資料匱乏，監管機構（FDA/EMA）的指引相對保守，需要個案評估。
blocks.en: Special challenges of E&L assessment for the eye: the eye (especially for intraocular injection) is in direct contact with neural tissue, so toxicity thresholds (TTC) cannot be applied directly from oral standards. In addition, ophthalmic TK/PK data are scarce, and regulators' (FDA/EMA) guidance is relatively conservative, requiring case-by-case assessment.

blocks.zh: 防篡改設計（Tamper-evident design）：眼用製劑包裝必須設計有防篡改特徵，以便使用者確認產品未被開封或污染，這既是患者安全設計，也是監管合規要求。
blocks.en: Tamper-evident design: ophthalmic packaging must be designed with tamper-evident features so that users can confirm the product has not been opened or contaminated. This is both a patient safety design and a regulatory compliance requirement.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一款單劑量眼用凝膠採用 LDPE 小袋包裝，客戶申請將包材供應商從 A 換到 B。這個變更是否需要重新進行 E&L 研究？應遵循什麼評估流程？
blocks.en: A single-dose ophthalmic gel is packaged in an LDPE sachet, and the client applies to change the packaging material supplier from A to B. Does this change require a repeat E&L study? What assessment process should be followed?

blocks.zh: Minimum Fill 〈755〉 是為了確保什麼？如果眼藥水瓶子裝量不足，對患者有什麼實際影響？
blocks.en: What does Minimum Fill <755> aim to ensure? If an eye drop bottle is underfilled, what is the practical effect on the patient?

blocks.zh: Specific Tests — 特定測試項目
blocks.en: Specific Tests

blocks.zh: viscosity（黏度）
blocks.en: Viscosity

blocks.zh: antioxidant content（抗氧化劑含量）
blocks.en: Antioxidant content

blocks.zh: resuspendability/redispersibility（再懸浮性/再分散性）
blocks.en: Resuspendability/redispersibility

blocks.zh: particle size and particle size distribution（粒徑及粒徑分布）
blocks.en: Particle size and particle size distribution

blocks.zh: drop size（滴量）
blocks.en: Drop size

blocks.zh: added substances（添加物質）
blocks.en: Added substances

blocks.zh: 黏度（Viscosity）的雙刃劍效應：黏度增加可以延長眼部接觸時間，但同時也可能妨礙藥物從劑型擴散進入眼組織。因此黏度不是「越高越好」，而是需要在「滯留時間」與「藥物釋放速度」之間找到平衡點。
blocks.en: The double-edged effect of viscosity: increasing viscosity can prolong contact time with the eye, but it may also hinder diffusion of the drug from the dosage form into the ocular tissue. Viscosity is therefore not "the higher the better"; a balance must be found between residence time and drug release rate.

blocks.zh: 再懸浮性（Resuspendability）的臨床意義：如果患者使用眼用懸浮液前沒有充分搖晃，或懸浮液形成了不可再分散的 cake（結餅），每次用藥的劑量就會不均一——嚴重情況下第一滴含藥量很低，最後幾滴含藥量過高，或完全無法再分散，導致給藥失敗。
blocks.en: The clinical significance of resuspendability: if the patient does not shake an ophthalmic suspension sufficiently before use, or the suspension forms a cake that cannot be redispersed, the dose delivered will not be uniform from one application to the next. In severe cases the first drop contains very little drug and the last few drops contain too much, or the product cannot be redispersed at all, resulting in dosing failure.

blocks.zh: Drop size（滴量）的臨床現實：眼結膜囊的容量只有約 7–10 µL，正常淚液約 7 µL，最大耐受量約 30 µL。點眼時若超過 30 µL，多餘藥液會從眼角溢出並進入鼻淚管（nasolacrimal duct），造成全身性吸收，引發不必要的副作用。因此 20–70 µL 的滴量範圍設計，讓一滴能有效給藥而不造成太多浪費。
blocks.en: The clinical reality of drop size: the capacity of the conjunctival sac is only about 7–10 µL, normal tear volume is about 7 µL, and the maximum tolerable volume is about 30 µL. If more than 30 µL is instilled, the excess liquid overflows from the corner of the eye and enters the nasolacrimal duct, causing systemic absorption and unnecessary side effects. The 20–70 µL drop size range is therefore designed so that one drop can deliver the drug effectively without much waste.

blocks.zh: 關鍵數字 Key Numbers
blocks.en: Key Numbers

blocks.zh:
眼結膜囊容量：~7–10 µL
正常淚液體積：~7 µL
最大耐受體積：~30 µL
標準滴量範圍：20–70 µL（USP 規定）

理想滴量設計目標：
  最大化角膜接觸 → 最小化溢出損失
  → 通常建議 25–35 µL

黏度與接觸時間（定性關係）：
  低黏度 (<5 mPa·s) → 迅速流走
  中黏度 (5–50 mPa·s) → 適度延長
  高黏度 (>50 mPa·s) → 長時間停留但可能模糊視線
blocks.en:
Conjunctival sac capacity: ~7–10 µL
Normal tear volume: ~7 µL
Maximum tolerable volume: ~30 µL
Standard drop size range: 20–70 µL (per USP)

Ideal drop size design target:
  maximize corneal contact → minimize loss from overflow
  → usually 25–35 µL is recommended

Viscosity and contact time (qualitative relationship):
  low viscosity (<5 mPa·s) → runs off quickly
  medium viscosity (5–50 mPa·s) → moderately prolonged
  high viscosity (>50 mPa·s) → stays a long time but may blur vision

blocks.zh: 再懸浮性就像調製沙律醬（油醋醬）：靜置後油水分離，使用前需要充分搖晃混合均勻，否則倒出來的油水比例每次都不同。眼用懸浮液就是如此——使用說明書上「使用前搖勻」不是建議，是確保劑量均一的必要步驟。
blocks.en: Resuspendability is like mixing a salad dressing (vinaigrette): after standing, the oil and water separate, and it must be shaken thoroughly to mix evenly before use, otherwise the oil-to-water ratio poured out is different every time. Ophthalmic suspensions are the same: "shake well before use" on the instructions is not a suggestion but a necessary step to ensure dose uniformity.

blocks.zh: 「Cake 形成」就像沙律醬靜置太久，沈澱的固體黏連結塊，再怎麼搖也搖不開——這是配方穩定性設計的失敗，在研發階段必須透過配方優化避免。
blocks.en: "Cake formation" is like a salad dressing left standing too long, where the settled solids stick together and cannot be shaken loose however hard you try. This is a failure of formulation stability design and must be avoided through formulation optimization at the development stage.

blocks.zh: 添加物質的顏色限制就像食品法規禁止「純裝飾性」食用色素：藥品中加顏色必須有功能性用途（如視覺化注射位置），不能為了讓藥品「好看」就添加可能引起眼部刺激的色素。
blocks.en: The color restriction on added substances is like food regulations banning purely decorative food colorings: adding color to a drug product must serve a functional purpose (such as visualizing the injection site); a dye that may cause ocular irritation must not be added just to make the product look nice.

blocks.zh: 特定測試 vs 通用測試的定義差異：本節的特定測試（viscosity, particle size, drop size 等）不是所有眼用製劑都需要，而是根據劑型特性選擇。例如：
blocks.en: The difference between specific tests and universal tests: the specific tests in this section (viscosity, particle size, drop size, etc.) are not needed for every ophthalmic product; they are chosen according to the characteristics of the dosage form. For example:

blocks.zh: 懸浮液 → 必須有粒徑、再懸浮性測試
blocks.en: Suspensions → particle size and resuspendability tests are required

blocks.zh: 溶液點眼藥 → 需要滴量測試
blocks.en: Solution eye drops → a drop size test is required

blocks.zh: 高黏度凝膠 → 需要黏度規格
blocks.en: High-viscosity gels → a viscosity specification is required

blocks.zh: 含抗氧化劑製劑 → 需要抗氧化劑含量測試
blocks.en: Preparations containing antioxidants → an antioxidant content test is required

blocks.zh: 黏度測試方法選擇依黏度範圍而定：〈911〉 毛細管法適合低黏度液體；〈912〉 旋轉法適合中高黏度；〈913〉 滾球法用於特定應用。在規格書中需指明方法及儀器設定。
blocks.en: The choice of viscosity test method depends on the viscosity range: the <911> capillary method suits low-viscosity liquids; the <912> rotational method suits medium to high viscosity; the <913> rolling ball method is used for specific applications. The specification must state the method and the instrument settings.

blocks.zh: 粒徑的穩定性挑戰：懸浮液和乳劑的粒徑在儲存期間可能因 Ostwald ripening（奧斯特瓦德熟化）或聚集而增大，這直接影響藥物吸收性和眼部刺激性，必須在加速穩定性和長期穩定性研究中監測。
blocks.en: The stability challenge of particle size: the particle size of suspensions and emulsions may grow during storage through Ostwald ripening or aggregation, which directly affects drug absorption and ocular irritation, and must be monitored in accelerated and long-term stability studies.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 設計一款眼用懸浮液（含皮質類固醇，局部點眼）的品質規格表，應包含哪些特定測試？
blocks.en: What specific tests should be included in the quality specification sheet for an ophthalmic suspension (containing a corticosteroid, topical eye drop)?

blocks.zh: 粒徑及分布（〈429〉）：確認藥物微粒 <10 µm，避免眼部刺激
blocks.en: Particle size and distribution (<429>): confirm drug particles are <10 µm to avoid ocular irritation

blocks.zh: 再懸浮性：搖晃 N 次後均一性符合要求（需定義搖晃方法）
blocks.en: Resuspendability: uniformity meets requirements after N shakes (the shaking method needs to be defined)

blocks.zh: 滴量（20–70 µL 範圍內）：需驗證瓶嘴設計
blocks.en: Drop size (within the 20–70 µL range): the nozzle design needs to be verified

blocks.zh: 黏度（如有加黏度劑）：確認批次間一致性
blocks.en: Viscosity (if a viscosity enhancer is added): confirm batch-to-batch consistency

blocks.zh: 抗菌防腐劑含量（如苯扎氯銨）：符合 〈51〉 全貨架壽命要求
blocks.en: Antimicrobial preservative content (such as benzalkonium chloride): meets <51> requirements over the entire shelf life

blocks.zh: 通用測試：pH、滲透壓、無菌性、微粒（〈790〉）、含量測定、雜質
blocks.en: Universal tests: pH, osmolarity, sterility, particulates (<790>), assay, impurities

blocks.zh: 某懸浮液在加速穩定性（40°C/75%RH）6 個月後，粒徑 D90 從 5 µm 增加到 18 µm。這個結果說明什麼問題？有哪些可能的原因和解決方向？
blocks.en: After 6 months of accelerated stability (40°C/75%RH), the D90 particle size of a suspension increased from 5 µm to 18 µm. What does this result indicate? What are the possible causes and directions for a solution?

blocks.zh: 客戶希望在眼藥水中加入藍色素以便區分左眼和右眼的兩種製劑（不同藥物，相同外觀）。根據 USP 〈771〉 的規定，這個需求可以被接受嗎？理由為何？
blocks.en: A client wants to add a blue dye to eye drops to distinguish two preparations for the left and right eye (different drugs, same appearance). Under USP <771>, can this request be accepted? What is the reasoning?

blocks.zh: USP 〈771〉 完整品質測試框架摘要 | Complete Quality Test Framework
blocks.en: Summary of the Complete USP <771> Quality Test Framework

blocks.zh: USP 〈771〉 品質測試框架的整體架構邏輯：
blocks.en: The overall architectural logic of the USP <771> quality test framework:

blocks.zh: 整個 〈771〉 的品質測試可用一個決策樹理解：
blocks.en: The quality tests of the whole of <771> can be understood as a decision tree:

blocks.zh: 所有眼用製劑都必須做的基礎測試（通用測試）：鑑別、含量、雜質、pH、滲透壓、可見微粒、無菌性、最小裝量、包材 E&L 評估、容器密封完整性
blocks.en: Basic tests that all ophthalmic products must undergo (universal tests): identification, assay, impurities, pH, osmolarity, visible particulates, sterility, minimum fill, packaging material E&L assessment, container-closure integrity

blocks.zh: 根據給藥途徑決定的追加測試：眼內注射追加內毒素、〈789〉；眼外非局部注射追加 〈788〉
blocks.en: Additional tests determined by route of administration: intraocular injections add endotoxins and <789>; extraocular non-topical injections add <788>

blocks.zh: 根據劑型特性選擇的特定測試：懸浮液加粒徑+再懸浮性；多劑量加防腐劑；含抗氧化劑加抗氧化劑含量；滴眼劑加滴量
blocks.en: Specific tests chosen according to dosage form characteristics: suspensions add particle size + resuspendability; multi-dose products add preservatives; products containing antioxidants add antioxidant content; eye drops add drop size

blocks.zh: 這個框架確保了從最基本的「是什麼藥」（鑑別）到「有多安全」（無菌、微粒、內毒素）到「能正常使用」（再懸浮性、滴量、黏度），每一環節都被覆蓋。
blocks.en: This framework ensures that every link is covered, from the most basic "what drug is it" (identification), to "how safe is it" (sterility, particulates, endotoxins), to "can it be used normally" (resuspendability, drop size, viscosity).

blocks.zh: 品質系統中的無菌優先原則再次確認：回顧整個 〈771〉，無菌性始終是第一位的要求。其他所有測試項目——無論是 pH、微粒、防腐劑、再懸浮性——都是在「無菌」這個基礎上的進一步品質確保。若無菌失敗，其他一切測試通過也無濟於事。
blocks.en: Reconfirming the sterility-first principle in the quality system: looking back over the whole of <771>, sterility is always the first requirement. All other test items, whether pH, particulates, preservatives or resuspendability, are further quality assurance built on the foundation of "sterile". If sterility fails, it is no use if everything else passes.

blocks.zh: USP 〈771〉 與 〈1771〉 的分工：〈771〉 = 產品品質（product quality），確保藥品「沒有問題」；〈1771〉 = 效能測試（performance tests），確保藥品「有用」。上市申請中兩個文件均需覆蓋。
blocks.en: The division of labor between USP <771> and <1771>: <771> = product quality, ensuring the drug product has "no problems"; <1771> = performance tests, ensuring the drug product is "useful". Both documents must be covered in a marketing application.

blocks.zh: USP 〈771〉 的完整品質測試框架，就像一棟建築的驗收清單：
blocks.en: The complete quality test framework of USP <771> is like the acceptance checklist for a building:

blocks.zh: 基礎結構（通用測試）：地基、牆壁、屋頂——每棟建築都需要，是不可缺少的基本要素
blocks.en: Basic structure (universal tests): foundation, walls, roof; every building needs them, and they are indispensable basic elements

blocks.zh: 用途相關要求（給藥途徑測試）：辦公大樓需要的消防系統比普通倉庫更嚴格，眼內注射製劑比局部眼藥水有更多要求
blocks.en: Use-related requirements (route-of-administration tests): an office building needs a stricter fire protection system than an ordinary warehouse, and intraocular injections have more requirements than topical eye drops

blocks.zh: 功能性配備（特定測試）：游泳池建築需要防水測試；懸浮液製劑需要再懸浮性測試
blocks.en: Functional equipment (specific tests): a building with a swimming pool needs a waterproofing test; a suspension preparation needs a resuspendability test

blocks.zh: 沒有一份測試清單可以「一刀切」適用於所有眼用製劑，需要依據製劑特性客製化，但 〈771〉 提供了系統性的決策框架。
blocks.en: No single test list is "one size fits all" for every ophthalmic product; it must be customized to the characteristics of the preparation, but <771> provides a systematic decision framework.

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO 品質主管，客戶帶來一款新的玻璃體內注射用長效緩釋聚合物懸浮液，請判斷需要哪些 USP 品質測試：
blocks.en: As a CDMO quality head, a client brings a new long-acting sustained-release polymer suspension for intravitreal injection. Determine which USP quality tests are needed:

blocks.zh: 通用測試全部適用（鑑別、含量、雜質、pH、滲透壓）
blocks.en: All universal tests apply (identification, assay, impurities, pH, osmolarity)
Particulates: <790> + <789> (intraocular injection)

blocks.zh: 無菌性：〈71〉（必須）
blocks.en: Sterility: <71> (mandatory)

blocks.zh: 細菌內毒素：〈85〉，限量 2.0 EU/dose/eye
blocks.en: Bacterial endotoxins: <85>, limit 2.0 EU/dose/eye

blocks.zh: 劑量均一性：〈905〉（單劑量注射器）
blocks.en: Dose uniformity: <905> (single-dose syringe)

blocks.zh: 最小裝量：〈755〉
blocks.en: Minimum fill: <755>

blocks.zh: 粒徑及分布：〈429〉（懸浮液）
blocks.en: Particle size and distribution: <429> (suspension)

blocks.zh: 再懸浮性（懸浮液）
blocks.en: Resuspendability (suspension)

blocks.zh: E&L 評估：注射器組件（橡膠活塞、玻璃筒、針頭覆蓋膜）
blocks.en: E&L assessment: syringe components (rubber plunger, glass barrel, needle cover film)

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性：〈1207〉
blocks.en: Container-closure integrity: <1207>

blocks.zh: 黏度（如聚合物有黏度影響）
blocks.en: Viscosity (if the polymer affects viscosity)

blocks.zh: 這份清單代表一個完整的眼用製劑品質規格框架，需要在 CMC 章節中逐項論證。
blocks.en: This list represents a complete quality specification framework for an ophthalmic product, and each item needs to be justified in the CMC section.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 劑量均一性適用於單劑量容器（內容量均一性或重量差異法，〈905〉）；最小裝量適用所有眼用製劑（〈755〉）
blocks.en: Dose uniformity applies to single-dose containers (content uniformity or weight variation method, <905>); minimum fill applies to all ophthalmic products (<755>)

blocks.zh: E&L 評估採個案風險評估方式，需考慮劑型、給藥途徑、使用期間及任何包材/製程變更；眼部路徑毒理資料匱乏是特殊挑戰
blocks.en: E&L assessment uses a case-by-case risk assessment approach, which must consider the dosage form, route of administration, duration of use and any packaging material/process changes; the scarcity of toxicology data for the ocular route is a special challenge

blocks.zh: 特定測試（黏度、粒徑、再懸浮性、滴量等）依劑型特性選擇適用，非強制通用
blocks.en: Specific tests (viscosity, particle size, resuspendability, drop size, etc.) are chosen as applicable to the dosage form characteristics and are not mandatory universal tests

blocks.zh: USP 〈771〉 整體框架：通用品質測試（基礎）→ 給藥途徑追加測試（微粒/內毒素）→ 劑型特定測試，三層架構確保全面品質覆蓋
blocks.en: The overall USP <771> framework: universal quality tests (basis) → additional tests by route of administration (particulates/endotoxins) → dosage form-specific tests; the three-tier structure ensures comprehensive quality coverage
